purpose: local software catalog-generation control; no cryptanalysis price or attack claim
timing_scope: generator main, including build/render/document check; excludes module import and independent digest
failure_rule: retain failed, invalid or interrupted arms with their actual status; do not pool failures as successful elapsed times
publication: each registered run has a bench.record/v1 entry, raw JSON and the standard progress report; existing CI uploads Git-tracked raw files and verifies S3 custody
